inspiration.title: Creative Inspiration
inspiration.novelPlaceholder: Enter your creative idea, e.g., A programmer wakes up in 1890s London and finds her debugging instincts work on clockwork machines.
inspiration.shortPlaceholder: Describe your story idea, e.g., Late night at a convenience store, an old man comes every night to buy the same discontinued candy.
inspiration.screenplayPlaceholder: Tell me what you want to shoot, e.g., A CEO is turned down on a dating app for listing a modest job, and keeps the act going to find real love.
inspiration.novelDesc: AI will help you conceptualize story framework, build world and characters based on your inspiration
inspiration.shortDesc: AI will help you refine story structure, making the short story more compelling
inspiration.screenplayDesc: AI will help you design episode plots, dialogue and twists, making the script more engaging

example.novel: e.g. A disgraced mapmaker is hired to chart a city that quietly redraws its own streets every night.
example.short: e.g. The night before her wedding, a bride finds a letter in her own handwriting begging her not to go through with it.
example.screenplay: e.g. A diner waitress learns the quiet regular she serves every morning is the billionaire who ruined her family.

ideaQuota.descriptionOnDay: They come back on {{day}} at 00:00 Beijing time (UTC+8). Your idea stays in the box; press "Start Writing" then to pick it up. To write now, get Pro: no daily message limit.
ideaQuota.descriptionTomorrow: They come back tomorrow at 00:00 Beijing time (UTC+8). Your idea stays in the box; press "Start Writing" then to pick it up. To write now, get Pro: no daily message limit.
ideaQuota.descriptionLocal: They come back on {{local}} your time (00:00 Beijing time). Your idea stays in the box; press "Start Writing" then to pick it up. To write now, get Pro: no daily message limit.
